Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by misunderstanding the release year of "Heroes Of The Street." Despite the WebSurfer's findings consistently indicating that "Heroes Of The Street" was released in 1922, the Planner introduced confusion by suggesting there might be later commercial release dates like 1992. This misunderstanding led to an incorrect assessment of which film came out earlier, despite having clear evidence that "Heroes Of The Street" was released in 1922. The Planner should have relied on the consistent 1922 release year for "Heroes Of The Street" and compared it to the conflicting dates for "Aanaval Mothiram."
